page.title: EVE Online in X4
page.descr: Faction names and notification texts for the EVE Online in X4 mod
page.t: A ruthless pirate organisation from EVE Online, known for fast ships and ambush tactics. They have no stations in X4 space and prey only on independent pilots.
Fanatical pirates from EVE Online who terrorise lone travellers. They own no stations here and hunt only the player.
Opportunistic pirates from EVE Online led by former military officers. They have no stations and attack only the player.
A mysterious slave-empire from EVE Online that fields heavily modified ships. They hold no stations and target only the player.
The interstellar police force from EVE Online. CONCORD pays bounties for every pirate ship destroyed, but has no stations of its own.
